title: Quick Load always selects the first resource that was in the list before typing when Instant Preview is enabled
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6.beta2.mono.official [551ce8d47]

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta2.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.22029.9039) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

When selecting a resource with Quick Load after typing into the search bar, it will always select the first item that was in the list before you began typing.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75c3d225-2431-44e9-baa1-d07d0afbcfd8

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached MRP.
2. Open node_3d.tscn located at the root of the project.
3. Select the CSGBox in the scene.
4. In the inspector, select Quick Load on the Material property.
5. Select any material without typing anything. It selects the correct material.
6. Reset the material property.
7. Type in "Green" or "Blue" and select the material in the list by either double-clicking or pressing Enter with the material highlighted.
8. Notice how it always chooses the Red material, which is the first in the list before typing anything.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[material-selection-mrp_2025-12-24_14-18-02.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24333085/material-selection-mrp_2025-12-24_14-18-02.zip)
